name: Ben (a Levite of the second rank, musician and gatekeeper under David)
title: Levitical Musician and Gatekeeper
summary: Ben was a Levite of the second rank who served under King David. He was appointed as a musician and gatekeeper in connection with the transport and storage of the ark of the covenant. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the Levitical service corps that David organized for worship in the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Appointment as a Levite of the Second Rank
keyEvents.description: Ben was appointed as one of the Levites of the second rank, subordinate to the leading Levites, to serve in the music and gatekeeping duties.

keyEvents.title: Musician with Harp
keyEvents.description: Ben was assigned to play the harp (nevel) in connection with worship when the ark of the covenant was brought to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Ark of the Covenant is Brought to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Ben participated as part of the Levitical music corps when the Ark of the Covenant was carried up to Jerusalem amid great celebration and worship.

keyEvents.title: Service Before the Ark of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: After the ark was placed in the tent David had pitched for it, Ben continued his service as a musician before the Ark of the Covenant in daily worship.
